bic_trace_step.reason: The commit introduces the vulnerable construct. In pm8001_task_exec(), when port->port_attached is false, the code directly calls t->task_done(t) (lines 407-408 and 420-421) in error paths. According to the vulnerability root cause, calling task_done() while returning an error (-ENODEV/SAS_PHY_DOWN) triggers a double-free because libsas assumes the task was unhandled and frees it again. This commit ADDS these task_done() calls without proper handling to prevent the double-free scenario. The code shows no protective mechanism like checking if task was already handled or using proper return codes that would prevent libsas from freeing the task again.
